name: Television Love
source:
Have you ever watched the hit tv show Teletubbies and thought "damn, why can't I date one of them?"

WELL NOW YOU CAN!

Choose a boy, delve into their tragic backstory (or pick Po) and try to forget the fact that they're literally just human versions of the colorful potato folk we all know and... know!

[Edited from [url=https://cicadabox-games.itch.io/television-love-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你有没有看过热门电视节目《天线宝宝》，然后想：“天哪，我为什么不能和其中一个约会呢？”

现在你可以了！

选择一个男孩，深入研究他们的悲惨背景故事（或选择阿宝），并尝试忘记这样一个事实：他们实际上只是我们都知道并且……知道的多彩土豆民族的人类版本！

[编辑自[url=https://cicadabox-games.itch.io/television-love-demo]itch.io[/url]]
